scope: Release version, attribution, launcher slot directory and UI build-version metadata only; inference binaries and results reused.
credit_statement: Credit for the original fast-prefill breakthrough goes to Halogen's creator, [Peonist.ai (`peonist-ai`)](https://github.com/peonist-ai/halogen-flash-server). [pwilkin](https://pwilkin.github.io/strix-halo/) reproduced that performance in an open-source llama.cpp implementation and published the kernels and configuration that CIRU adapted for these existing weights. CIRU's contribution is the compatibility integration and validation.
